name: @navis/bridge-daemon
description: Per-user bridge daemon: single-instance lifecycle, platform IPC, keychain credential storage.

scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.json --pretty false && node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync } from 'node:fs'; cpSync('src/persistence/migrations', 'dist/persistence/migrations', { recursive: true }); cpSync('src/security/windows-access.ps1', 'dist/security/windows-access.ps1');"
